name: topk_sigmoid
description: Fused sigmoid top-k routing. gating_output is [num_tokens, n_experts]; scores are sigmoid(gating_output) in float32, and each row's K largest scores are selected and written in descending-score order. topk_weights and topk_ids are caller-provided [num_tokens, K] buffers, with ids int32. When renormalize is true the selected weights are rescaled to sum to 1 and multiplied by routed_scaling_factor; otherwise the raw sigmoid values are written. Tie ordering is not part of the contract; suites use fp32 logits to keep the ordering well defined. The native kernel mutates both topk_weights and topk_ids in place and returns the same two tensors. Suites exercise float32 gating and weights with int32 ids, including renormalize on/off.
